# Introducing Screen Studio 4.0
## Channel: Screen Studio
1.1K subscribers
80 likes

### Description
1,036 views
Posted: 2026-10-31
Screen Studio 4.0 is here. It's our biggest update yet.

Screen Studio is the screen recorder for Mac that handles the hard parts: zooms, motion, sound, and framing. Every demo and tutorial comes out polished.

What's new in 4.0:
• Glass Loupe: magnify one detail under a glass lens
• Camera cutout: appear in your video without your background
• Edit by transcript: delete a sentence to cut it from your video
• Split screen: you and your screen side by side, or stacked for vertical video
• Hide sensitive data and faces: covered and blurred for you, on your Mac
• Sharper zooms, ProRes, up to 4x faster exports, and more

results.title: Screen Studio 4.0: Glass Loupe, Camera Cutout, Edit by Transcript, and more | ChatGate
results.content:
Screen Studio 4.0 is a Mac screen recorder that edits your demo while you record: it follows the cursor with automatic zooms, smooths pointer motion, and frames webcam footage, audio, and captions so the export looks professionally cut. Version 4.0, which maker Adam Pietrasiak called the team's biggest update yet on Product Hunt, adds transcript-based editing, a background-free camera cutout, and a magnifying Glass Loupe to an app that already handled the hard parts of zooms, motion, sound, and framing, as described on the official website.

## What is new in Screen Studio 4.0? [...] Screen Studio 4.0 consolidates the three jobs that used to force creators into second apps — cutting by transcript, framing the presenter, and hiding secrets — into the recorder itself. Download the free trial from the official website and record your next demo in it; if the auto-zoomed, transcript-trimmed export survives your audience, the subscription pays for itself.

## Related apps [...] The headline addition is edit by transcript: delete a sentence from the transcript and it is cut from the video, with filler words and long pauses detected so they can be removed in one pass, according to FounderMag's launch coverage. That moves Screen Studio into territory previously owned by dedicated text-based editors: transcript editing headlines the official changelog for the early-October 2026 release, as an independent feature breakdown confirms. The second addition is the camera cutout, in beta, which removes the webcam background on-device with no green screen required. A new split-screen layout places the presenter beside or above the recording, including stacked vertical-video layouts, and face tracking centers the camera while hiding it during silence.

Glass Loupe: Magnify details through a glass lens. Use it when a standard zoom would cause too much movement on your screen.
 Split Screen: Show yourself and your screen either side by side or one above the other in a vertical video. Screen Studio will animate every layout change.
 Edit by Transcript: Edit your videos the way you would edit text. Delete a sentence from your transcript to remove it from your video. Filler words and long pauses are highlighted for you.
 Camera Cutout: Appear in your video without your background. Screen Studio can remove your background on a Mac and place you in front of your screen. [...] Copied!
